highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 updates the native rendering engine to Skia m157 without changing the managed API surface.
highlights_body: This unreleased line also makes calling conventions explicit in generated LibraryImport bindings. Graphite Metal adopts a native iOS and tvOS 15 runtime minimum.

breaking.title: Graphite Metal requires iOS and tvOS 15
breaking.body: The native Graphite Metal backend now requires iOS or tvOS 15. Apps using this backend must deploy to version 15 or later while continuing to meet any higher managed or framework requirements. Its macOS minimum remains 12.

bullets.detail: Updates the native engine to milestone 157 while preserving the fork's m156 glyph-bounds guard. Managed wrappers and generated declarations are unchanged by this engine update. HarfBuzz stays at native version 14.4.0; its package revision advances from 14.4.0.100 to 14.4.0.200.

Generated LibraryImport bindings for SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, SceneGraph, Skottie, and Resources now explicitly use cdecl, matching DllImport and delegate paths. This addresses a Windows x86 ABI mismatch; runtime validation of the reported stack growth in optimized calls remains outstanding.
